channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: An archaeological dig at the Bennington Battle Monument uncovered what may be a historic tavern. Artifacts include a King George the Third coin and mason-marked pipe pieces. The site will be open to visitors through tomorrow before preservation work begins.

One million dollars in funding is now available to dairy farmers in the Northeast. Farmers in New York, Vermont, and New Hampshire can apply for modernization grants. This program covers eleven states to support farm improvements.

Rutland is updating how it replaces police cruisers, now factoring in idling time as part of mileage wear. One hour of idling equals thirty miles of driving, officials say. The policy change awaits final approval by the city and state.

A Poultney man has been convicted of multiple sexual assault charges involving a child. William Rice Jr. faces life in prison for his crimes, a Rutland County court ruled. Sentencing will be determined in the coming months.
